capabilities: Browse the latest seven daily notes in a page-like layout with flip animation
Preview or edit daily notes in place within the diary view
Store quote, weather, mood, and image metadata in daily note frontmatter
Fetch a daily quote from an optional user-configured API and cache it in frontmatter
Configure week start, weekend days, language, and frontmatter key names
extras: The plugin works offline by default and only makes network requests when a daily quote API URL is configured.
motivation: The README says the notebook mood, diary-first interaction model, and page-turning presentation were inspired by the Dear Diary plugin.
problem: Obsidian shows daily notes as plain Markdown files, with no dedicated reading or writing view that presents them together as a diary.

relations.evidence: This plugin's notebook mood, diary-first interaction model, and page-turning presentation were inspired by Dear Diary

summary: Notebook-style diary view that renders recent daily notes as flippable pages with quote, weather, mood and image metadata stored in frontmatter.
